description: Native desktop Matrix client built on the Matrix Rust SDK
notes: Tesseract stores all config, session and cache data in %APPDATA%\Tesseract (profiles get a -NAME suffix, e.g. %APPDATA%\Tesseract-work). This location is outside the Scoop install directory, so it is NOT persisted by Scoop and survives app updates/uninstalls.
The installer is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn on first run: click 'More info' then 'Run anyway'.
The exe doubles as a CLI: tesseract.exe supports --help, --profile=NAME, --open-room, --logoutall (see docs/CLI.md).
checkver matches tags like v0.9.2; autoupdate URL uses Tesseract-<version>-AMD64.exe (version has no leading v).
